Applies to the service type “Hochzeit” (wedding). Without a couple and without a part number the bracketed groups disappear.
Höher heißt größere Dateien, nicht hörba: Higher means larger files, not audibly better speech. 192k is the value that grew out of practice.
Icecast- oder RTMP-Adresse. Enthält Zuga: Icecast or RTMP address. Contains credentials — masked in displays and logs. Empty means: use the target from the .env.

Legt jeden Track eines Gottesdienstes ei: Stores every track of a service a second time under CopyCenter, in that folder's own scheme: 2026_mp3/Gottesd_261018_So_mp3_a with an empty text file as its label. Weddings and other recordings are not included.

Session hat keine Aufnahmedatei: The session has no recording file
So lange muss Ton anliegen, damit er als: Sound must hold this long to count as a real start.
This much quiet must precede the start. Pauses between sentences are around 500 ms and must not count, or the edge jumps around in continuous speech.
Spitzenpegel: jedes Segment so laut, das: Peak level: each segment is raised until its loudest moment reaches the peak level — quiet sermons stay quiet. Loudness: every segment sounds equally loud (EBU R 128), peaks stay below −1 dBTP.
Steht in jeder MP3 als Interpret, meist: Written into every MP3 as the artist, usually the name of the church. Leave empty if no artist should be set.
Stream-Ziel in den Einstellungen setzen: Set the stream target in the settings
Verschiebt den Schnitt auf die leiseste: Moves the cut to the quietest point nearby. Edges set by hand are left alone.
Virtuelle Soundkarte BlackHole fehlt: Virtual sound card BlackHole is missing
Vorauswahl für den Schalter „Online stel: Default for the “Publish online” switch on export: uploads every track of a service with subtitles and AI analysis to the church app. Credentials are in audio-service/.env (ONLINE_*).
Wertet die Ansagen im Transkript aus, um: Reads the announcements in the transcript to guess the type of the next item. Titles always stay display-only.
Wie viele der fünf Klangmerkmale für Spr: How many of the five acoustic features must vote for speech.
Wie weit um den gesetzten Zeitpunkt nach: How far around the marked moment the quietest point is looked for.
Wird nach dem letzten Ton zusätzlich beh: Kept in addition after the last sound.
Wird vor dem ersten Ton zusätzlich behal: Kept in addition before the first sound.
Takes effect only after a service restart.
Woran die Automatik in einer Ansage erke: How automatic mode tells from an announcement which item is coming. The first matching rule wins. Every congregation announces differently — “our choir will sing” does not fit everywhere. Try a pattern before saving it.
What each segment is normalised to. −3 dBFS leaves room for further processing.
Während einer Aufnahme kann der Gottesdi: The service cannot be changed while a recording is running
Während einer Aufnahme nicht änderbar: Cannot be changed during a recording
Zieht Anfang und Ende jedes Tracks auf d: Pulls the start and end of each track onto the actual audio when the button came too early or too late. Runs when the recording stops. Where there is no real pause — during continuous speech, say — your mark stays put.
